<!-- Do not name real organizations, clients, products or people. Describe the context so that it can be understood, not identified. -->

## Context

Type of organization, domain, size, and the operational situation, anonymized.

## Which part of the specification

Document ID or term (for example `META-OBJECT-01`, `SPEC-05`, `ocom:Ownership`) and the sentence or rule you applied.

## What happened

What the situation required, and what the specification allowed, required or forbade.

## Where they differ

The gap in one or two sentences.

## Independence

The change process (`docs/Governance/Standard Evolution Methodology.md`) asks whether this case is independent of the ones already recorded: a different author, a different domain or a different operational context. Say which.

## Evidence

What can be shared: documents, records, counts, dates, with confidential material removed.

## Proposed disposition

- [ ] Record as an Architecture Observation
- [ ] Open an ADR Candidate
- [ ] Editorial correction only
- [ ] Not sure, asking for a review
